description: Header file defining functions and classes for efficient string set lookup using DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). Includes external references to string handling and export macros, and defines a class for incremental membership and prefix queries.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: Class providing incremental, space-efficient lookup and prefix matching in a fixed set of strings represented as a DAFSA.

methods.name: LookupStringInFixedSet
methods.description: Performs a fast lookup to determine if a string is in a fixed set, returning a status code or bitmap of rules.

methods.name: LookupSuffixInReversedSet
methods.description: Finds the longest matching suffix in a reversed DAFSA for a given host string.

methods.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lookup with a graph; supports incremental character addition and result retrieval.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Adds a character to the current input sequence for prefix/membership testing.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Returns the result code for the current input sequence, indicating membership or rule matches.
